newsitem.title: USA: PXRE, Transnational shareholders approve merger.
newsitem.headline: PXRE, Transnational shareholders approve merger.

text.p: PXRE Corp said on Monday its shareholders and Transnational Re Corp shareholders have approved and adopted the merger agreement between the two companies.
The merger, which is expected to be completed on December 11, was subject to closing conditions, they said.

Upon completion of the merger, Transnational Re would cease to exist and PXRE will continue as the surviving corporation. Transnational Re's reinsurance unit would become a subsidiary of PXRE Reinsurance Co, the companies said.
In the merger, Transnational Re holders would receive 1.0575 shares of PXRE common stock for each Transnational share. Cash will be paid in lieu of fractional shares.

Separately, PXRE also said its stockholders approved an amendment to to increase the number of authorized shares of PXRE common stock to 40 million shares. The company was not available to comment on how many authorized shares it had currently.
